creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`keymap.rs:38` is `pub enum Action {}`, an empty placeholder so `Resolution` is not a lie about a shape that does not exist. `bindings.rs:26` is the real vocabulary: 44 variants, `ALL` at 137, `as_str` at 233.

This is what sent `a_2KHGYh7xD` at the wrong file. Its card said to log a bound chord beside `input.bound.text` in `pane_input.rs`, which cannot work - that arm is uninhabitable while the enum next door is empty, and every action on macOS arrives through a menu key equivalent instead.

Renaming one of them, or moving the placeholder somewhere its emptiness is obvious, would stop the next reader losing the same evening.
title: 🎭 Two types named Action in crates/muster-core/src/input/
